reuse.why: Calls the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked guard, link.findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse and the syncAccount dispatch, and registers the provider in SYNC_PROVIDERS and server-config like the others.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount repeats the Akahu/PluggyAI link body (upgrade-or-insert, payee, initial sync, notify) and downloadFintegraTransactions repeats the Akahu download, as the tree's per-provider pattern invites.

placement.why: Each piece sits where the tree keeps that provider concern: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, base URL in server-config, account type in types/models.

scope.why: Server-side Fintegra support only, as requested; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow, but every provider's link flow is now one more copy, and the compressed Fintegra variants (no 'error' branch in the download) quietly diverge from their siblings.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions are condensed rewrites of linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions (one-line ifs, destructuring, an error branch dropped) rather than shared code.
